allowance(address,address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of tokens of type `id` that `spender` is allowed to spend on behalf of `owner`. NOTE: Does not include operator allowances.

approve(address,uint256,uint256).details: Sets an approval to `spender` for `amount` of tokens of type `id` from the caller's tokens. An `amount` of `type(uint256).max` signifies an unlimited approval. Must return true.

balanceOf(address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of tokens of type `id` owned by `owner`.

params.controller: The address that receives the vault request back
params.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID to cancel

decimals(uint256).details: Returns the number of decimals for the token of type `id`.

isOperator(address,address).details: Returns true if `spender` is set as an operator for `owner`.

name(uint256).details: Returns the name of the token of type `id`.

params.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID to check

returns._0: True if the vault has not yet processed the request

params.owner: The address whose shares are burned
params.receiver: The address that receives the settled assets or vault shares
params.shares: The number of shares to burn
params.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID to redeem from

returns.assets: The amount of assets or vault shares transferred to the receiver

params.assets: The amount of underlying assets to deposit
params.owner: The address whose assets are pulled
params.receiver: The address that receives ERC-6909 tokens and becomes the token owner
params.vault: The ERC-7540 vault to request a deposit on

returns.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID representing the wrapped request

params.owner: The address whose vault shares are pulled
params.receiver: The address that receives ERC-6909 tokens and becomes the token owner
params.shares: The amount of vault shares to redeem
params.vault: The ERC-7540 vault to request a redeem on

returns.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID representing the wrapped request

setOperator(address,bool).details: Grants or revokes unlimited transfer permission of any token id to `spender` for the caller's tokens. Must return true.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

symbol(uint256).details: Returns the ticker symbol of the token of type `id`.

totalSupply(uint256).details: Returns the total supply of the token of type `id`.

transfer(address,uint256,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` of token type `id` from the caller's account to `receiver`. Must return true.

params.controller: The current controller of the request on the vault
params.receiver: The address that receives ERC-6909 tokens and becomes the token owner
params.requestId: The vault request ID to transfer
params.vault: The ERC-7540 vault that holds the pending deposit request

returns.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID representing the wrapped request

transferFrom(address,address,uint256,uin.details: Transfers `amount` of token type `id` from `sender` to `receiver`. Must return true.

params.controller: The current controller of the request on the vault
params.receiver: The address that receives ERC-6909 tokens and becomes the token owner
params.requestId: The vault request ID to transfer
params.vault: The ERC-7540 vault that holds the pending redeem request

returns.tokenId: The ERC-6909 token ID representing the wrapped request

cancel(uint256,address).notice: Cancels a wrapped request by transferring the vault request back to the specified controller via ERC-8161. Burns all ERC-6909 tokens and deletes the request. Only callable by the token owner or their operator. Only allowed if the owner still holds all shares (no transfers have occurred). The vault must support ERC-8161 transferable requests.

pending(uint256).notice: Returns whether the underlying vault request is still pending.

redeem(uint256,uint256,address,address).notice: Burns ERC-6909 shares and claims the corresponding portion directly from the underlying vault via deposit() or redeem(). Each call executes a partial claim against the vault. The request must not be pending (vault has fulfilled it). Only callable by the owner or their operator. The return amount is determined by the vault's exchange rate at execution time.

requestDeposit(address,uint256,address,a.notice: Pulls underlying assets from the owner, originates a new async deposit request on the vault via an isolated delegate, and mints ERC-6909 claim tokens to the receiver. The vault must support IERC7540Deposit. The caller must be the owner or their operator on this contract. The owner must have ERC-20 approval for the underlying asset to this contract.

requestRedeem(address,uint256,address,ad.notice: Pulls vault shares from the owner, originates a new async redeem request on the vault via an isolated delegate, and mints ERC-6909 claim tokens to the receiver. The vault must support IERC7540Redeem. The caller must be the owner or their operator on this contract. The owner must have ERC-20 approval for the vault shares to this contract.

transferDeposit(address,uint256,address,.notice: Transfers an existing ERC-8161 pending deposit request into the fungibility contract, minting ERC-6909 claim tokens to the receiver. The vault must support IERC7540Deposit and IERC8161DepositTransferable. The caller must be the controller or their operator on this contract. This contract must be set as an operator on the vault for the controller.

transferRedeem(address,uint256,address,a.notice: Transfers an existing ERC-8161 pending redeem request into the fungibility contract, minting ERC-6909 claim tokens to the receiver. The vault must support IERC7540Redeem and IERC8161RedeemTransferable. The caller must be the controller or their operator on this contract. This contract must be set as an operator on the vault for the controller.
